'''Gmsh''' is a [[Finite element method|finite-element]] [[Mesh generation|mesh generator]] developed by Christophe Geuzaine and Jean-François Remacle. Released under the [[GNU General Public License]], Gmsh is [[free software]].

Gmsh contains 5 modules: for geometry description, meshing, solving and post-processing. Gmsh supports [[Parametric equation|parametric input]] and has advanced visualization mechanisms. Since version 3.0, Gmsh supports full [[constructive solid geometry]] features, based on [[Open Cascade Technology]].<ref>{{Cite journal | doi=10.1002/nme.2579|title = Gmsh: A 3-D finite element mesh generator with built-in pre- and post-processing facilities| journal=International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering| volume=79| issue=11| pages=1309–1331|year = 2009|last1 = Geuzaine|first1 = Christophe| last2=Remacle| first2=Jean-François|bibcode = 2009IJNME..79.1309G| s2cid=110330097 | url=https://hal.archives-ouvertes.fr/hal-03406365/file/Geuzaine2009.pdf }}</ref><ref>Science and Technology of Advanced Materials - 3D physical modeling of anisotropic grain growth at high temperature in local strong magnetic force field - Eric Beaugnon - (2008) 024201 (6pp) - [http://www.iop.org/EJ/article/1468-6996/9/2/024201/stam8_2_024201.pdf?request-id=670d498f-0c55-4866-994d-a71cc81008be].</ref>

A modified version of Gmsh is integrated with SwiftComp, a general-purpose multiscale modeling software. The modified version, called [https://cdmhub.org/resources/scstandard Gmsh4SC], is compiled and deployed on the Composites Design and Manufacturing HUB ([https://cdmhub.org/ cdmHUB]).

== Interfaces ==

Various graphical user interfaces exist that integrate Gmsh into their workflow:
* A Matlab interface available with [[FEATool Multiphysics]].
* The Mesh and FEM Workbenches of [[FreeCAD]] support Gmsh for meshing inside the program, along with other meshers like [[Netgen]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ngsolve.org/|title=Netgen/NGSolve|website=ngsolve.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://wiki.freecadweb.org/Mesh_FromPartShape#Gmsh_mesher|title=Mesh FromPartShape - FreeCAD Documentation|website=wiki.freecadweb.org}}</ref>
